title: Synthetic Household Profile
description: Schema for a single synthetic household profile. Consumed by the WASM microsimulation engine in Phase 2. Generated by the SDV CopulaGAN pipeline with OpenDP differential privacy guarantees (ε ≤ 1.0).

age.description: Age of the reference person in years

patrimoine.description: Total net wealth in EUR (real estate + financial assets - debt)

revenu_fiscal.description: Fiscal reference income (Revenu Fiscal de Référence) in EUR

nombre_parts.description: Number of tax shares (parts fiscales) in the quotient familial

zone_residence.description: Geographic zone of residence (1 = Île-de-France, 2 = major cities, 3 = rest of territory)

enfants_a_charge.description: Number of dependent children in the household

loyer_mensuel.description: Monthly rent in EUR (0 if homeowner)
